name: synapse
description: Graph-grounded answers about your codebase. A local knowledge graph with graph-validated reasoning and hallucination checks, using the AI you already have (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Codex).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Synapse runs its engine only in trusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Use the first assistant you're signed in to: GitHub Copilot, then Claude Code, then Codex.
Language models provided to VS Code (GitHub Copilot and any other installed model providers).
The Claude Code CLI, using your Claude subscription (bundled with the Claude Code extension or on PATH).
The Codex CLI, using your ChatGPT sign-in (bundled with the Codex extension or on PATH).
synapse.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Which AI assistant Synapse uses for **Ask** and **Enrich Graph**. Synapse never needs an API key: it uses your existing sign-in. Building, searching and verifying are fully local and use no AI.

synapse.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model to use with the selected provider. Leave empty for the provider's default. Easiest to set with **Synapse: Choose AI Model**.

synapse.autoBuildOnOpen.description: Build the knowledge graph automatically when a workspace with source code is opened. Local only; no AI is used.

synapse.autoUpdateOnSave.description: Refresh the graph incrementally a moment after you save a source file. Local only; no AI is used.

synapse.queryBudget.description: Maximum tokens of graph context returned per search (also used for context given to Copilot agent mode).

synapse.pythonPath.description: Python 3.10+ interpreter used to set up Synapse's private engine environment. Leave empty to detect automatically.

synapse.devPackagePath.markdownDescription: Development only: install the engine from a local checkout of the Synapse repository (editable install) instead of the engine bundled with the extension.

languageModelTools.name: synapse_query
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the functions, classes and relationships relevant to a question.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the repository knowledge graph for code relevant to a natural-language question. Uses relationship-weighted, community-aware graph retrieval and returns a compact set of relevant symbols (with file and line) and their relationships (calls, imports, inheritance, methods). Use this before reading whole files to find where things are and how they connect.

question.description: A natural-language question about the codebase, e.g. 'how does authentication work'.

languageModelTools.name: synapse_explain
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show a symbol's location and its direct relationships.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Look up one function, class or file in the repository knowledge graph and return its location plus its direct neighbours: what calls it, what it calls, what it imports, and what contains it.

symbol.description: Exact name of a function, class or file, e.g. 'validate_url' or 'build.py'.

languageModelTools.name: synapse_verify_code
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check proposed code for symbols, imports and methods that don't exist in this repository.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Before writing or suggesting code, check it against the repository knowledge graph. Reports imports, functions and methods the code references that the graph CONTRADICTS (e.g. a method that does not exist on a class that does), plus which references are SUPPORTED or UNKNOWN. Use it to catch hallucinated APIs. Python is checked most precisely.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:engine && npm run build:assets && npm run compile
scripts.pretest: npm run build:assets && npm run compile
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:engine && npm run test:integration
